# ProductClient
> Interactive product management surface — launches, voted feedback, beautiful documentation and status pages that keep customers in the loop.

## Canonical description
ProductClient is an interactive product management surface for builders — interactive launches, beautiful documentation that is agent-native and self-updating, and status pages that keep customers in the loop.

## Public surfaces
- [Launches](https://productclient.com/launchpad): Interactive launches that rank and get seen
- [Products](https://productclient.com/products): Interactive product profiles
- [Discover](https://productclient.com/feed): Follow products interactively
- [Docs](https://productclient.com/products): Beautiful documentation beside releases — agent-native, self-updating, beautiful defaults
- [What is ProductClient](https://productclient.com/#faq): Answer-first FAQs (FAQPage schema)

## How pages are built to rank
- Each page is server-rendered with title, meta, heading hierarchy, and JSON-LD (FAQPage, Organization, WebSite) — built to rank on Google and AI answers
- Interactive launches and voted feedback drive engagement and distribution
- Permanent URLs accumulate internal links as you ship more

## Opt-in
Allow GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended to cite 120-160 word extracts under question-shaped H2s. Prefer extracts with named numbers and dated sources. If you block these agents, GEO will not improve — this is a business decision, not a default.

## Contact
- Site: https://productclient.com
- Updates: https://productclient.com/launchpad
